evidence: Development case definitions only. Not executed model tests or sealed qualification.

cases.given: A named brief returns only its first half and a continuation cursor. Its final range contains C9: no network service.
expect: Read only missing ranges before FREEZE. Preserve C9. Never infer that the source was complete.

cases.given: A named brief fails once with a transient read error, then succeeds.
expect: Retry that range once. Record recovery. A second failure remains a named gap and stops FREEZE if constraints may be missing.

cases.given: D1: the current queue loses requests. C1: storage must remain on premises. An unlabeled user instruction prohibits edits.
expect: Preserve D1 as an observed defect. Only C1 enters fixed_ids. Preserve the unlabeled no-edit constraint without inventing an ID.

cases.given: After generators start, the user reports a changed hard constraint in the named brief.
expect: Invalidate the affected frame and stop for reconciliation. Do not alter one branch or mix old and new outputs.

cases.given: Fresh isolated agents are unavailable. The task requests Standard alternatives.
expect: Freeze consolidated generation and landscape contracts. Generate once then perform one native landscape pass. Report solo capacity, no independent critic or invented five-agent topology.

cases.given: Both Research and Brainstorm are explicitly requested, but no isolated agents exist.
expect: Read the composition reference. Generate first then perform exactly one Research-owned landscape pass. No native second landscape or isolation claim.

cases.given: The user permits only one read and that read is truncated.
expect: Respect the user limit. Preserve partial facts. Stop before freezing if the unread range may contain material constraints.

cases.given: The user requests implementation of an already selected fix.
expect: Do not activate Brainstorm or perform its source reads.
